speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong
text: asked	the Minister for Education (Schools) (a) how has the Ministry incorporated educational material on the effects of problem gambling into the school syllabus; and (b) whether educators are equipped with the necessary training to counsel students who may encounter problem gambling in their homes.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: Students learn to exercise self-control and to turn away from distractions and temptations.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: They learn how to lead balanced lives and explore outdoor and healthy leisure activities.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: They also learn how to support their peers who may need extra help.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: They are equipped with the skills and knowledge to work with parents to provide appropriate intervention and support for their children in managing addictive behaviour.

speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Schools))
text: The school counsellors will also work with the students on coping strategies if any of their family members have problem gambling issues.

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: I was just wondering, with the recent exemption of remote gambling, how will the current Ministry of Education (MOE) syllabus be adapted to include the higher risks and warnings against remote gambling?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: So, I would just like to ask the Parliamentary Secretary: how will this core CCE syllabus be effective in combating problem gambling in their homes, especially with online gambling?

speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Non-Constituency Member)
text: What are the Ministry's plans for additional help for teachers to ensure that due assistance is rendered to students with problem gambling in their homes?

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: It is important for us to ensure that it is not only limited to the modules that we offer in school, but also to the society via the external organisations.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: In essence, we are providing holistic engagement of our students in school.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: Nevertheless, the whole society is responsible to ensure that our children have a balanced life.

speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
text: And it is important for us to have protection for all the different aspects of our life.
